uri.normalize.invalid_algorithm: a URI carries no algorithm field
uri.normalize.invalid_claim: a URI carries no claim fields
uri.normalize.invalid_duplicate: a URI has no member structure to duplicate
uri.normalize.invalid_key: a URI carries no key material
uri.normalize.invalid_limit: a URI carries no bounds-tightening limit
uri.normalize.invalid_nonce: a URI carries no nonce field
uri.normalize.invalid_request: a URI is not a request
uri.normalize.invalid_time: a URI carries no temporal field
uri.normalize.maximum_plus_one: no fixed input-width ceiling exists to exceed (URI length is bounded by uri_bytes, pinned via bounds.new)

verify_anchored_export.boundary_near: verify_anchored_export returns export facts; no near-boundary analogue exists
verify_anchored_export.exact_bound: the export facts are a value, not a bounded artifact
verify_anchored_export.invalid_algorithm: the anchored-export input carries no top-level algorithm field; its embedded anchor and transition JWS compacts DO carry alg headers, but their algorithm-confusion rejection is the identical anchor/transition alg-pin exercised directly on the verify_historical_anchor and verify_key_transition surfaces (invalid_algorithm-none), so a verify_anchored_export-level case re-frames the archive without exercising any distinct verifier behavior
verify_anchored_export.invalid_duplicate: the archive header duplicate-member is rejected at parse as invalid_encoding
verify_anchored_export.invalid_limit: the anchored export carries no bounds-tightening limit
verify_anchored_export.invalid_nonce: the anchored export carries no nonce
verify_anchored_export.invalid_request: the export is not a request
verify_anchored_export.invalid_selector: the anchored export carries no selector
verify_anchored_export.invalid_uri: the anchored export carries no URI field
verify_anchored_export.maximum_plus_one: the export is bounded by archive_bytes, archive_chunks (65796), and historical_key_transitions (256), all pinned at bounds.new and caller-tightenable there, so a maximum_plus_one case would exceed one of them; but the over-bound structured array (65797 chunks or 257 transitions) exceeds the loader's case-file json_bytes ceiling (65536) and the .raw sidecar is single-blob only, so the input cannot be carried as a corpus case
